name: Cerebrolysin
subtitle: Porcine peptide mixture
summary: Injectable peptide mixture with decades of stroke and dementia trials across Europe and Asia — respectable but heterogeneous results.
caveat: Trials are in stroke and dementia patients with heterogeneous results; it is an IV/IM clinical product.
